provenance.proof: Setting scalar graph generators and all positive jets to zero computes the diagonal quotient, leaving QQ[M]/(I_d, grad P). Every active potential monomial has at least two Casimir factors; differentiating leaves at least one. Thus grad P is contained in (I_d), and the diagonal quotient is exactly the nilcone. Basic invariants form a regular sequence over QQ.
